liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Know You Rider** (3 reviews): The jam breaks loose around the five-minute mark of the song; The transition from China Cat Sunflower to I Know You Rider roars [31][32][37]
- **She Belongs to Me** (2 reviews): Jerry delivers soulful, lyrical guitar phrasing during this specific performance; Garcia sings the words with grace and nails the tune [39][42]
- **US Blues** (1 review): Jerry belts out the lyrics energetically during this rocking number [39]

## The recordings

- **gd85-06-15.sbd.griesman.5682.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 148 min; rated 4.44/5 by 32 [1]. Said about its sound: The performance is described as tight, consistent, smooth, and deceptively refreshing; The soundboard features prominent Phil bass and excellent overall balance; The soundboard recording has poor pitch, disappointing the listener [33][35][41]
- **gd1985-06-15.matrix.chappell.85832.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 148 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1985-06-15.sbd.etter.20878.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 145 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1985-06-15.148770.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 146 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Bobby noted fog rising as the sun set during the performance [31]
- The reviewer was born on the day of this specific concert [34]
- Reviewer calls the second set one of the best of the 1980s [32]
- Reviewer considers this the best version of Touch of Gray ever [35]
- Reviewer calls this their favorite show from that specific run [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd85-06-15.sbd.griesman.5682.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> ?> CD-R> EAC> CDWAV retrack> SHN [1]. Also: Audio transferred from SBD to CD-R, then EAC to SHN via Randy Griesman [1]
- **gd1985-06-15.matrix.chappell.85832.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info files for details; transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Matrix: (SBD/AUD mix) See info file for details [2]. Also: Both SBD sources were synchronized to the AUD source [2]
- **gd1985-06-15.sbd.etter.20878.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Peter Etter; source: compiled from two different bootleg CDs; patched from Oade AUD [3]. Also: Compiled from two bootlegs, with Doug Oade's AUD repairing a bad edit [3]
- **gd1985-06-15.148770.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics (135 degrees, x/y pattern, mounted on pole 7' high)(13 rows up from walkway, behind soundboard) >… [4]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplies a six-second patch in Drums [4]
